title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Particulars of a Registered Notice
content:
The grounds on which a notice under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` can be rejected the moment it is on file are tested against the particulars of one specific claim file.

## The file examined

The file examined is the claim file on the cover that stands at notice registered. Since a cover holds a single open claim, that file is at the same time the latest notice the cover has received.

## Particulars read from it

| Particular | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| amount | the amount claimed on the notice-registered file |
| Container | the Container named on the most recent notice |
| kind of loss | the kind of loss on the most recent notice |
| visible at delivery | whether the most recent notice flags the loss as visible when the goods were delivered (its Apparent-at-delivery entry) |
| notice date | the date the most recent notice reached the line |

## What the examination rests on

Every particular above comes from a registered claim file; none is taken from the claimant's account of the loss or from any earlier file on the cover.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

A cover has three claim files: one settled, one withdrawn, and one registered today for Container AHLU5123450, shortage, not visible at delivery, 1840.00 USD. The grounds are tested on the third file: amount 1840.00, Container AHLU5123450, shortage, not visible at delivery, notice date today.
